metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows how to quickly get rid of upper back pain with an easy step-by-step guide.

This video will show the best method towards healing an upper back injury, including what to do first and what exercises (and stretches) are the most effective. 

As a bonus, all of the exercises can be done at home, require no equipment, and may give upper back pain relief within 30 seconds.

Watch now and fix your upper back pain!

0:00 Intro
0:58 Muscle Warm Up 
4:05 Strengthening Exercise 1
